extracted_item: OCA says raw, calibrated, and auxiliary data for analyses are associated with the CMSM REGARDS portal and user support.
ONERA points mission users to https://cmsm-ds.onera.fr/user/microscope for MICROSCOPE data.
REGARDS advertises OpenSearch/GeoJSON/STAC discovery and HTTP file serving.
rs-access-project proxies rs-catalog and rs-storage for search/product access and quotas.
access-project exposes catalogue search endpoints, including dataobjects/datasets search.
MICROSCOPE analysis used 4 Hz accelerometer measurements, same-stamp attitude/angular velocity/angular acceleration, and minute-sampled satellite position/velocity.
corrected X-axis model uses polynomial drift plus gx,gz,Sxx,Sxz columns.
